ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (133) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Tolstoy's Russian ship name «Богородица Ветров» (Bogoroditsa Vetrov, 'Mother of God of the Winds') is given as “Our Lady of the Winds,” the English equivalent of Maupassant's Notre-Dame-des-Vents; the French names Célestin Duclos, Françoise, and Perpignan are restored, while «Кашо» (Kasho), whose French original is uncertain, is transliterated. Françoise's «наша сестра» (nasha sestra, literally 'our sister', idiomatically 'we women') is kept as “we sisters” to preserve its echo of the title, and «девка» (devka, 'girl', coarse) is 'girl'.
